fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Normalized ISO-8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the event occurred.
fields.justification: Essential for 3x02 time-window correlation rules and 3x03 timeline reconstruction during incident triage.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Fully qualified domain name or netbios name of the host generating the event.
fields.justification: Required by 3x03 analysts to isolate affected endpoints and track lateral movement across machines.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Specific log collector or technology origin such as sysmon, security, auditd, or zeek.
fields.justification: Allows 3x02 detection rules to apply parser logic specific to underlying log generation capabilities.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level category of the event such as authentication, process, file, network, or audit.
fields.justification: Needed by 3x02 detection rules and 3x03 triage filters to group events independently of source vendor.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized criticality level of the event mapped to low, medium, high, or critical.
fields.justification: Enables 3x03 triage queues to prioritize high-risk security alerts over routine operational noise.

source_mapping.linux_text: derived from syslog priority / audit type
source_mapping.network_csv: derived from threat intelligence / alert level

fields.name: user
fields.description: Account name or user identity associated with the event execution.
fields.justification: Critical for 3x02 compromise detection rules focusing on privilege escalation and unauthorized account activity.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name or full executable path of the process initiating the action.
fields.justification: Used by 3x02 rules to detect malicious execution signatures and living-off-the-land binary abuse.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IPv4 or IPv6 address originating the network communication.
fields.justification: Required for 3x03 analysts to identify external attackers or compromised internal originators.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IPv4 or IPv6 address receiving the network communication.
fields.justification: Enables 3x02 command-and-control detection rules by matching destinations against threat intelligence feeds.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Unmodified original log entry or event payload prior to normalization.
fields.justification: Provides 3x03 forensic analysts an uncorrupted audit trail to verify edge cases during investigation.

fields.name: command_line
fields.description: Full command-line arguments executed by the process.
fields.justification: Essential for 3x02 detection rules to identify obfuscated PowerShell or malicious script execution.

fields.name: process_id
fields.description: Numeric process identifier assigned by the operating system.
fields.justification: Allows 3x03 analysts to trace parent-child process trees during endpoint incident response.
